title: 第一卷 第29章 是狂，还是强？
content_zh:
“少宗主，此子如此嚣狂，依老夫之见，也没必要再和他多说什么了，不如直接杀了得了。”

    冷风华身后，一个骑着黑毛巨狼的方脸老者，目中冒着寒光道。

    冷风华点头笑道：“陆长老所言极是。本想陪他多聊几句，奈何他自己急着寻死。既然如此，诸位长老就送他上路吧。”

    “云鸢，我们后退一些，别让他的脏血，溅到了我们。”

    冷风华邪肆一笑，催动黑虎，往后方退了退。

    他在谢家也听说了秦绝的战绩，知道秦绝的战力有些妖孽，自然不敢自己上前送死。

    但即便知道了秦绝一刀双杀两名大宗师的战绩，冷风华也绝对的信心能够杀了秦绝！

    一来，凤州城的草包大宗师，岂能和他灵山宗的大宗师相提并论？

    二来，他带来的，可是四名大宗师！即便那四个宗师境巅峰是凑数的，可八头异兽，实力却是毋庸置疑的！

    这样的阵容，别说是杀一个大宗师了，就算是对上灵溪境初期的强者，也有一战之力！

    “这么着急跑作甚？我倒是还有几句话，想和你聊聊。”秦绝冲着退后的冷风华淡淡道。

    冷风华玩味道：“哦？你想聊什么？是想知道云鸢把我伺候的舒不舒服吗？你若真的想知道，我倒是不介意告诉你。”

    谢云鸢眼中浮起羞怒，紧咬着红唇，却不敢说话。

    只有她自己知道，她嫁给冷风华之后，得到的并不是宠爱，而是无尽的羞辱……

    她更清楚，如果杀掉她父兄的人不是秦绝，或许冷风华根本不会来管谢家这趟子事。

    秦绝淡淡道：“她已是你的妻子，我并不关心她的事情。我只是有点好奇，你带了四个大宗师出来，灵山宗内还能剩下几个大宗师？”

    冷风华眉头一挑：“你好奇这个做什么？”

    秦绝笑道：“你先回答，我便告诉你，我为何好奇。”

    冷风华哼声道：“还剩五人，怎么了？”

    秦绝眼眸一眯，唇角掀起一抹冰冷的笑容：“那真是可惜了。今日杀不过瘾，来日去了你灵山宗，还是没法杀过瘾！”

    秦绝此话一出，在场所有人的瞳孔，都瞪大了一些！

    这人，是疯了吗？

    居然还想着杀上灵山宗！

    李东明也是愕然的看着秦绝的侧脸，没想到少爷竟是这么能装啊……

    “哈哈哈哈！秦绝啊秦绝，你的狂，还真是超乎我的想象！”冷风华怒笑道。

    秦绝淡淡道：“我的强，也一样会超乎你的想象。”

    下一刻，他眼神一厉，双目之中杀气迸发而出！

    “大白，出来吃肉了！”

    唰！

    在冷风华等人惊疑之时，一道白影，从院门后方爆冲而出，落在秦绝身边。

    李东明眼眸一震，这不是窝在院角的那只白狼吗？

    难道这就是少爷的底牌？
content_en:
"Young Master, this boy is so arrogant. In my opinion, there is no need to say anything more to him. It is better to just kill him."

    Behind Leng Fenghua, an old man with a square face riding a black-furred giant wolf said with a cold look in his eyes.

    Leng Fenghua nodded and smiled: "What Elder Lu said is absolutely true. I wanted to chat with him for a few more words, but he is eager to die. In this case, the elders will send him on his way."

    "Yun Yuan, let's move back a little, don't let his dirty blood splash on us."

    Leng Fenghua smiled evilly and urged the black tiger to retreat back.

    He had also heard about Qin Jue's achievements at the Xie family. He knew that Qin Jue's fighting power was somewhat monsterous, so naturally he did not dare to go forward and die himself.

    But even after knowing Qin Jue's record of killing two great masters with one sword, Leng Fenghua was absolutely confident that he could kill Qin Jue!

    First of all, how can the idiot grand master of Fengzhou City be compared with the grand master of his Lingshan Sect?

    Secondly, he brought four great masters! Even though the four peak Grandmaster realms are just a handful, there is no doubt about the strength of the eight-headed beasts!

    Such a lineup, not to mention killing a great master, is still capable of fighting even a strong person in the early stage of Lingxi Realm!

    "Why are you running in such a hurry? I still have a few words that I want to chat with you." Qin Jue said calmly to Leng Fenghua who was retreating.

    Leng Fenghua said playfully: "Oh? What do you want to talk about? Do you want to know whether Yunyuan is comfortable serving me? If you really want to know, I don't mind telling you."

    Xie Yunyuan's eyes were filled with shame and anger, and she bit her red lips tightly, but did not dare to speak.

    Only she knew that after marrying Leng Fenghua, what she got was not favor, but endless humiliation...

    She knew better that if the person who killed her father and brother was not Qin Jue, maybe Leng Fenghua would not take care of the Xie family's affairs at all.

    Qin Jue said calmly: "She is your wife, and I don't care about her affairs. I am just a little curious. You have brought four great masters out. How many great masters are left in Lingshan Sect?"

    Leng Fenghua raised his eyebrows: "What are you curious about?"

    Qin Jue smiled and said, "You answer first, and I will tell you why I am curious."

    Leng Fenghua snorted: "There are five people left, what's wrong?"

    Qin Jue's eyes narrowed, and a cold smile appeared at the corner of his lips: "That's a pity. I can't kill enough today. If I go to your Lingshan Sect tomorrow, I still won't be able to kill enough!"

    As soon as Qin Jue said these words, the pupils of everyone present widened a little!

    Is this person crazy?

    He actually wanted to kill the Lingshan Sect!

    Li Dongming also looked at Qin Jue's side face in astonishment. He didn't expect that the young master could be so good at pretending...

    "Hahahaha! Qin Jue, Qin Jue, your madness is beyond my imagination!" Leng Fenghua laughed angrily.

    Qin Jue said lightly: "My strength will also exceed your imagination."

    The next moment, his eyes sharpened, and murderous aura burst out from his eyes!

    "Dabai, come out to eat meat!"

    Uh-huh!

    When Leng Fenghua and others were in shock, a white shadow burst out from behind the courtyard door and landed next to Qin Jue.

    Li Dongming's eyes trembled. Isn't this the white wolf nesting in the corner of the courtyard?

    Could this be the young master’s trump card?
